title: The 25-Minute Rule For Influencing Anyone ⏳ #shorts
description:
Speaker reveals how he mastered the 'time distance problem' when forced to conduct 45 interrogations in just two days, with only 25 minutes per session. He explains that the key to influencing behavior rapidly isn't about deleting trauma or problems, but about radically shifting perspective to achieve desired outcomes quickly. ⚡
